description: This Swift source file defines the main entry point for the Watch app extension of an iOS application. It sets up the main application structure, manages state for the inbox store and connectivity receiver, and constructs the app's main scene with an inbox view that handles reply actions via WatchConnectivity.

classes.name: OpenClawWatchApp
classes.description: The main application struct conforming to the App protocol, setting up state and the main scene for the watch app.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main scene of the app, incorporating a WindowGroup that contains the WatchInboxView and manages sending replies via WatchConnectivityReceiver.
